shape.description: int or tuple of int Shape of the empty array, e.g., ``(2, 3)`` or ``2``.

dtype.description: data-type, optional Desired output data-type for the array, e.g, `numpy.int8`. Default is `numpy.float64`.

order.description: {'C', 'F'}, optional, default: 'C' Whether to store multi-dimensional data in row-major (C-style) or column-major (Fortran-style) order in memory.

device.description: str, optional The device on which to place the created array. Default: ``None``. For Array-API interoperability only, so must be ``"cpu"`` if passed.

like.description: array_like, optional Reference object to allow the creation of arrays which are not NumPy arrays. If an array-like passed in as ``like`` supports the ``__array_function__`` protocol, the result will be defined by it. In this case, it ensures the creation of an array object compatible with that passed in via this argument.

output.description: ------- ndarray Array of uninitialized (arbitrary) data of the given shape, dtype, and order. Object arrays will be initialized to None.
